instructions.text: Poach or grill the clams (scrubbed) until just cooked, then slice thinly.
Whisk the dressing — lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, garlic and chili — until the sugar dissolves.
Combine the clams with shredded cabbage, carrot, Asian basil & mint.
Pour over the dressing and toss well just before serving.
Pile onto a plate and top with extra herbs, peanuts and fried shallots.
